subject: Conflicting reinforcement detail for the slab-on-deck pour strip between Structural

messages.text: The slab-on-deck pour strip reinforcement shown in Structural General Notes S-001 conflicts with additional #5 ties noted in Foundation Plan S-101. We would like this resolved ahead of the next concrete pour. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification. We need a response within one business day, if at all possible. Some on our side would call this more pressing than others do -- it's a judgment call either way.

Proceed with additional #5 ties per Foundation Plan S-101; Structural General Notes S-001 is superseded. This may generate a change order depending on the direction taken. No schedule impact is expected from this clarification.
To confirm before we place concrete: does this direction -- additional #5 ties -- apply at every slab-on-deck pour strip on this level, not just the one called out in Structural General Notes S-001?
